note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 24 November 2026, RealHunt lists 27 homes for sale in Greece, each one checked by a person.
In Greece, the median asking price of those 27 homes is €155,000 (€1,477 per m², from the 26 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €68,000 and the most expensive €199,000.
Taxes and fees add about 5.5–7% to the price of a home in Greece (figures as of 2026).

buying.costs_breakdown: Transfer tax 3.09% of the price or the taxable value, whichever is higher; notary about 0.8-1% plus VAT; land registry fees about 0.5-0.7%; lawyer 1-2% plus VAT; if an agent is used, the buyer usually pays a commission of 1-3% plus VAT on top.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. Buyers from outside the EU and EFTA need a permit to buy in designated border areas (parts of northern Greece and eastern Aegean islands such as the Dodecanese and Rhodes). The government has announced a 15% transfer tax for non-EU buyers of homes from 1 January 2027, not yet final in September 2026.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners on 1 January pay the unified property tax (ENFIA), calculated per property from its location, size, age and official zone value, with an extra charge if total Greek property exceeds €500,000.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-residents pay Greek tax on Greek rental income at 15% up to €12,000, 25% to €24,000, 35% to €36,000 and 45% above, after a flat 5% deduction for expenses.

homes.title: Three-bedroom village house with a vine-covered terrace and sea views in Messinia
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de tres dormitorios con terraza de parra y vistas al mar en Mesenia
homes.summary: A 116 m² two-storey house in Vasilitsi, at the southern tip of the Messinian peninsula, with views over the sea and the hills: three bedrooms, two kitchens, two living rooms and two bathrooms, a covered veranda and a vine-shaded terrace with blue railings, plus a roof terrace with views of the sea and mountains. Air conditioning, double glazing and wooden floors. Memi and Ammoudi beaches are about 3 km away. Asking €109,000, about €940/m².

homes.title: Whitewashed Cretan village house with a roof terrace and spiral stairs
homes.title_es: Casa encalada en un pueblo de Creta con azotea y escalera de caracol
homes.summary: A renovated 93 m² detached house in the traditional village of Choumeriako, 3 km from Neapoli and 13 km from the beaches of Agios Nikolaos. Downstairs, a modern kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom with a corner bath; a spiral staircase leads up to a lovely sitting room with a wood stove that opens onto a big terrace with umbrellas and views over the village. Stone arches, wooden beams and whitewashed walls keep its old character. Asking €115,000, about €1,237/m².

homes.title: Two-level stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de dos plantas con vistas al mar en Marathokampos, Samos
homes.summary: A well-kept 80 m² stone house in the upper part of Marathokampos, in the Agia Triada area, with a wonderful view of the sea. On the ground floor a kitchen, a dining room and a bathroom; upstairs two bedrooms, a living room, a hall and a WC. Wooden window frames, parquet and tiled floors and a wood boiler for heating. A traditional house in a picturesque spot, ready to live in. Asking €68,000, about €850/m².

homes.title: Stone island house with blue doors and a sea view over to Skiathos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra en la isla con puertas azules y vistas al mar hacia Skiathos
homes.summary: A 110 m² stone maisonette in Paleo Klima, Glossa, on the Mamma Mia island of Skopelos, with an open, unobstructed view of the Aegean and Skiathos. Bright blue shutters and doors, wooden beamed ceilings, a traditional fireplace corner, a sunny kitchen-living room and two bedrooms over two levels. Close to the main road with easy access, and sold ready to move into. Asking €150,000, about €1,364/m².

homes.title: Four-bedroom village house with a sea-view roof terrace in Othos, Karpathos
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de cuatro dormitorios con terraza con vistas al mar en Othos, Karpathos
homes.summary: A three-floor house of 165 m² in Othos, the highest village on Karpathos, renovated in 2014. Four bedrooms and four bathrooms, a large separate kitchen with a breakfast bar and a bright tiled living room. The top floor opens onto a wide terrace that looks over the white village, the hills and the Aegean. It is connected to mains water and sewage, and the village centre is a walk away. The advert puts Pigadia, the island capital and ferry port, 12 km away and Sikelao beach 8 km away. Asking €170,000, about €1,030/m², low for an island house this size.

homes.title: Renovated detached stone house with courtyard in Andriani, Messinia
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra adosada renovada con patio en Andriani, Mesinia
homes.summary: A detached stone house of 148 m2 in the village of Andriani, freshly renovated and set on a plot of about 500 m2. The photos show new timber floors, new wooden windows and doors, a fitted white kitchen and modern tiled bathrooms. Downstairs is a large living and dining area with a bathroom, and upstairs two big bedrooms, two more bathrooms and a balcony with country views. Two entrances, one onto a paved courtyard and garden by the kitchen, the other onto private parking. The seaside village of Agios Andreas is 7 km away and Kalamata about 50 km. Agency fee is extra.

homes.title: Traditional corner house in Agiasos, Lesbos' mountain village
homes.title_es: Casa tradicional de esquina en Agiasos, el pueblo de montaña de Lesbos
homes.summary: A traditional corner residence with two bedrooms in Agiasos, at about 460 m on the green slopes of Mount Olympus on Lesbos, a village known for pottery and woodcarving. Freshly painted facade with balcony, stone and wood details inside, and the island's beaches and olive groves around it.

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a Libyan Sea view in Agios Vasileios, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con vistas al mar de Libia en Agios Vasileios, Creta
homes.summary: A 61 m² stone house in the village of Agios Vasileios (Viannos), renovated in 2010, with a sweeping view over olive groves to the Libyan Sea from its terraces. An open living room and kitchen under wooden beams, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a small storeroom in the yard, on a 148 m² plot with parking outside. Sold furnished. Energy rating D. Asking €76,000, about €1,246/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone house with a sea view in Marathokampos, Samos
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra reformada con vistas al mar en Marathokampos, Samos
homes.summary: A renovated two-storey stone house in the Profitis Ilias quarter of Marathokampos, high above the bay, with a wide sea view from the balcony and windows. Downstairs a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom open onto a small courtyard; upstairs two bright bedrooms. Double glazing and air conditioning; sold furnished and with appliances, ready to move into. Energy rating F. Asking €80,000, about €1,250/m².

homes.title: Fairy-tale house with a gazebo and stone BBQ in the Pelion forest
homes.title_es: Casa de cuento con cenador y barbacoa de piedra en el bosque de Pelion
homes.summary: Surrounded by towering trees in the mountain village of Chania in Pelion, a 68 m² single-family house renovated in 2021 on a 213 m² corner plot: a wood-lined living room with a fireplace, a bedroom with its own fireplace, a modern kitchen, a bathroom and a small veranda, plus a 29 m² basement, two storerooms, a built-in stone BBQ and a large covered gazebo in a green garden. Sold with furniture and three inverter air conditioners. Asking €95,000, about €1,397/m².

homes.title: Renovated single-storey country house among olive groves near Gytheio
homes.title_es: Casa de campo unifamiliar renovada entre olivos cerca de Gytheio
homes.summary: A single-storey house of 82 m2 on an 845 m2 hillside plot with 17 olive trees, a citrus tree and a vine pergola, recently renovated: new floor tiles inside and out, new kitchen cupboards, restored timber roof, shutters and doors, fresh paint. Living room, kitchen with WC, two bedrooms, an extra room for dining or office, and a bathroom with bath. Two covered terraces look over the olive groves. Air conditioning in three rooms, mains water and electricity, septic tank. Sold largely furnished. Only three other houses nearby, so it is very quiet and you will need a car.

homes.title: Furnished Cretan house with a shared pool for just four homes
homes.title_es: Casa amueblada en Creta con piscina compartida entre solo cuatro casas
homes.summary: Villa Dionysos: a fully furnished 76 m² two-bedroom house over two floors in a small, quiet complex in Drapanos, near Chania. A bright open-plan living room with a corner sofa and fireplace opens onto a covered private terrace; the kitchen and dining area look out over the pool, shared by only four houses and backed by open countryside. Upstairs, two double bedrooms, each with its own terrace, the master with sea views. Asking €158,000, about €2,079/m².

homes.title: Renovated stone village house with courtyards in Karydi, eastern Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de pueblo de piedra renovada con patios en Karydi, Creta oriental
homes.summary: A stone house of 160 m2 on two levels in the hill village of Karydi, renovated in two stages, 2010 and 2024, and sold fully furnished. The ground floor has an open kitchen with a sitting corner by the fireplace, a large living and dining room, a double bedroom and a big bathroom with laundry area opening to the yard. Upstairs is a second bedroom with two balconies. Front and back yards, a store room, solar water heating and air conditioning in the living room and both bedrooms. About 20 to 25 minutes by car from Elounda and Neapoli, and an hour from Heraklion airport.

homes.title: Renovated old stone house with private courtyard in Neapoli, east Crete
homes.title_es: Casa antigua de piedra renovada con patio privado en Neapoli, Creta oriental
homes.summary: An old stone house on a quiet cul de sac a few minutes on foot from the centre of Neapoli, a lively Cretan market town with shops, banks and a weekly produce market. The owners renovated it to a high standard: double glazing with shutters and insect screens, oil central heating, air conditioning, solar hot water and a fitted kitchen with dishwasher. A gated, tiled courtyard leads to the living room, kitchen and shower room, with a double bedroom, cloakroom and sun terrace above, plus a loft that could become a second bedroom. About 93 m2. Agios Nikolaos and its beaches are about 11 km away.

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with a sea view in Pefki, North Evia
homes.title_es: Piso amueblado de dos dormitorios con vistas al mar en Pefki, norte de Eubea
homes.summary: A 50 m² first-floor flat a few hundred metres from the beach in Pefki, on the island of Evia, with a sea view from the balcony. Two bedrooms, a fitted kitchen, a modern shower room and a dining corner, all freshly finished with light floors. Electric heating, air conditioning, a security door and parking. Sold fully furnished and equipped, ready to use. Energy rating E. Asking €80,000, about €1,600/m².

homes.title: Modern, furnished two-bedroom house near the sea on Rhodes
homes.title_es: Casa moderna y amueblada de dos dormitorios cerca del mar en Rodas
homes.summary: An 84 m² detached house in Paradeisi on Rhodes, in very good condition, modern, bright and sold furnished: a stylish kitchen with a breakfast bar and pendant lights, a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. Air conditioning, a solar water heater, aluminium frames and tiled floors, with no shared expenses. Close to the sea, shops, cafés and the island's airport. Asking €155,000, about €1,845/m².

homes.title: Stone-built three-bedroom house with gulf views in Ano Volos, at the foot of Pelion
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de tres dormitorios con vistas al golfo en Ano Volos, al pie del Pelion
homes.summary: A stone-faced house built in 2004 in Agios Georgios, an old quarter of Ano Volos on the road up to Portaria. 114 m² on three levels with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, two kitchens and a living room with a fireplace. A veranda and a small garden face west over Volos and the Pagasetic Gulf. Oil central heating with radiators, new air conditioning units, a solar water heater, a storage room and private parking. Sold partly furnished. The advert puts the Volos waterfront 6.5 km away and Anavros beach 6 km away. Asking €167,000, about €1,465/m².

homes.title: Restored 1881 stone mansion with castle views in Volissos, Chios
homes.title_es: Mansión de piedra de 1881 restaurada con vistas al castillo en Volissos, Quíos
homes.summary: A stone house from 1881 in Volissos, in the north-west of Chios, once the village courthouse and later its school. Fully restored in 1998 and upgraded again in 2015: insulation, double glazing, a new tiled roof, solar hot water, renewed wiring and plumbing. 129 m² on two floors plus an attic bedroom under exposed beams, with two kitchens with marble worktops, two fireplaces and two bathrooms. The upper balcony looks over the village to the Genoese castle. The ground floor can work as a separate studio for guests. Asking €175,000, about €1,360/m².

homes.title: Brand-new 2025 cottage with a pergola deck 400 m from the sea in Halkidiki
homes.title_es: Casita nueva de 2025 con porche de pérgola a 400 m del mar en Calcídica
homes.summary: A new-build 72 m² house from 2025 in Kallikrateia, Halkidiki, energy class A and sold furnished: three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and three bathrooms, with a big wooden pergola deck, string lights for summer evenings, a garden with banana plants, parking, A/C, double glazing and a BBQ. The sea is 400 m away and Thessaloniki airport about 45 km. Asking €159,990, about €2,222/m².

homes.title: Furnished 1850 stone house with courtyard and mountain views in Milea, West Mani
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de 1850 amueblada con patio y vistas a la montaña en Milea, Mani Occidental
homes.summary: A two-level stone house in traditional Mani style, first built around 1850 and rebuilt in 2003, in the quiet hill village of Milea. About 132 m2 including the thick stone walls, on a 233 m2 plot with a stone courtyard and a covered terrace looking over the mountains. The ground floor has a living room with fireplace, kitchen and WC, and the upper floor a second living room, bathroom and bedroom, reached inside or by an outside stair. Two air conditioning units, and it is sold fully furnished and ready to use. The agency fee of 3% plus VAT is extra.

homes.title: Restored three-bed stone house with roof terrace in Kritsa village, Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de tres dormitorios restaurada con terraza en la azotea en el pueblo de Kritsa, Creta
homes.summary: A restored stone house a short walk from the square of Kritsa, the largest village around Agios Nikolaos and 7 km from the town and sandy beaches. A plant-filled terrace under a pergola leads to a furnished roof terrace with views over the mountains, the village and the sea in the distance. Inside are wood-beamed ceilings, stone walls, a living room with a wood stove, a fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and three bathrooms. It is sold furnished and in very good condition. Car access is about 70 m away, with public parking 100 to 150 m away.

homes.title: Wooden island-style house with a BBQ terrace hanging over the Pagasetic Gulf
homes.title_es: Casa de madera estilo isla con terraza y barbacoa sobre el golfo Pagasético
homes.summary: In the cobbled, island-like village of Trikeri at the tip of Pelion, a 54 m² house on two levels: a carefully renovated wooden studio with a high ceiling, a loft with a double bed, kitchen, dining area and bathroom, opening onto a big covered terrace with a wood oven, a BBQ and a fantastic view of the sea. Below, a separate 15 m² studio with its own kitchen and shower. Sleeps six; use it as one house or two holiday flats. Asking €120,000, about €2,222/m².

homes.title: Two-storey stone house facing the Libyan Sea in Koutsounari, south Crete
homes.title_es: Casa de piedra de dos plantas con vista al mar de Libia en Koutsounari, sur de Creta
homes.summary: A two-storey stone house with open views of the Libyan Sea, 1.3 km from Long Beach on the south coast of Crete. A stone-paved courtyard under a pergola faces the sea, and inside stairs lead up to a large view terrace. The living room has wood beams and a fireplace, and there is a separate traditional kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, all tiled. Hot water comes from a solar panel, and there is parking outside. Shops and tavernas open all year are a 3-minute drive away. About 88 m2 for 195,000 euros.

homes.title: Summer cottage on a 980 m² garden plot 2 km from the beach
homes.title_es: Casita de verano en una parcela de 980 m² a 2 km de la playa
homes.summary: A 62 m² house on a flat plot of 980 m² among olive trees and just a few neighbours, near Marathopolis: a sitting area with a wood stove, an open kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room downstairs, and a wooden staircase up to an attic with a balcony and extra beds. A garden with paths, a storeroom and a built-in BBQ. 2 km to Lagouvardos beach, 15 minutes to Gialova and its golf courses, 25 to Pylos. Asking €158,000, about €2,548/m².

homes.title: Restored stone courtyard house with a sea-view roof terrace in Gytheio
homes.title_es: Casa de patio de piedra restaurada con terraza con vistas al mar en Gytheio
homes.summary: A traditional stone house of 85 m2 on a quiet car-free lane in the old town of Gytheio, a short walk from the harbour front, on a 127 m2 walled plot. Restored with original stone paving, wooden floors and old doors kept. A stone-floored living room opens to the courtyard, where a newly renovated kitchen and an outdoor shower sit under a lemon tree. Upstairs are a double and a single bedroom and a modern shower room, and a raised terrace looks over the rooftops to the sea. Sold turnkey; Mavrovouni beach is 5 minutes by car.

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom flat with sea views in Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki
homes.title_es: Piso de dos dormitorios amueblado con vistas al mar en Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki
homes.summary: A 60 m2 first-floor flat in a two-storey building in Nea Fokea, a seaside village on the Kassandra peninsula of Halkidiki. The advert says the sea can be seen from the windows and that the owners will leave the furniture. Open living room with a modern fitted kitchen and wood stove, two bedrooms and a shower room, with windows on two sides and a covered balcony with awnings. Air conditioning, oil central heating with radiators and solar water heating. The photos show a well-kept home ready to use.

homes.title: Furnished one-bedroom ground-floor flat with a private yard in Elounda, Crete
homes.title_es: Apartamento de planta baja amueblado de un dormitorio con patio privado en Elounda, Creta
homes.summary: A ground-floor flat of 35.5 m² in Elounda, one of the best-known resort towns in Crete, sold fully furnished and ready to use. An open kitchen and living room with air conditioning opens onto a front balcony, and the double bedroom gives straight onto a private walled yard with a tree and a seating area. Modern shower room, solar panels for hot water and a 20 m² basement storage room. The advert puts Agios Nikolaos under 10 minutes away by car and Heraklion airport about an hour away. Asking €125,000, a low entry price for Elounda.
